latest_decision: Atom.Header.Container is an ordinary single Property holding a full Scope Unit path or a base Atom ID selecting Current by default; Header.Relations is optional and contains no duplicate Container entry. IS_CONTAINED_BY/CONTAINS and +>/<+ remain MODEL/Formal Claim relations, not Property aliases. Scope Unit root formal containment and the Declaration Atom Header are distinct.
supersedes: Prior suspended removal-of-Relation and pending-operator assumption; user has explicitly retained MODEL/Formal Claim relations and notation.
ownership: Root/source lane owns source and the planned mechanical data migration after reviewed source/schema checkpoint. CA #3 owns implementation, runtime, fixtures and tests. Workbench/Workflow owners retain their files.

human_decision: Containment storage moves from Atom.Header.Relations to Atom.Header.Container; Atom.Header.Relations is optional.
Every Atom has exactly one immediate Container. Each non-Project Scope Unit has one immediate Container; the Project root has zero.
The graph IS_CONTAINED_BY remains Direct and has one authored fact read from Container.
